findings.message: Coordinates with 4+ decimals: round to 0–2 decimals to reduce size and reveal misalignments.
5 distinct colours. ~75% of reference logos use ≤3; each extra colour costs recall and reproduction.
1782 anchor points — more than 95% of comparable reference logos (median 53.0). Simplify: fewer points, merged shapes, less detail.
